Bardaei , ōrum, m.,
I.an Illyrian people (in Cic. Fam. 5, 9, 2, Vardaei)—Hence, Bardăĭcus , a, um, adj., Bardœan calceus, a kind of soldier's boot, poet. for the soldiers themselves, Juv. 16, 13 (cf. Caligula)' cuculli, Capitol. Pertin. 8, 3; cf. bardocucullus.— Absol.
Bardăĭcus , i, m., a soldier's boot, Mart. 4, 4. 5.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
